newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco gasoline prices firm on draw, Clark.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco gasoline prices firm on draw, Clark.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline prices for November barrels firmed in Chicago on a draw in gasoline supplies and an ongoing refinery outage.

The American Petroleum Institute said gasoline inventories in the PADD III Midwest region were drawn down a net 1.19 million barrels, leaving stocks 5.24 million barrels below the same week last year.

Traders said Clark Refining and Marketing Co is actively seeking prompt November barrels following a court decision that idles two processing units at its Blue Island, Ill., refinery pending a court decision on operations at the plant.
API said Midwest distillate inventories rose a net 390,000 barrels in the region for the week ended October 25, leaving stocks 3.98 million barrels above the prior week's levels.
Chicago prompt November unleaded gasoline was talked 3.0/3.25 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded futures, with later deliveries 1.25/1.50 cents over the print.
Group Three unleaded for late-October deliveries was talked 0.25/0.50 cent a gallon over November unleaded futures.

Chicago November low sulphur diesel was talked even to 0.25 cent over the print for prompt deliveries and 1.50/1.75 cents over for later deliveries. High sulphur opened November trade 1.75 cents under the print, traders said.
Group Three late-October low sulphur diesel was talked 2.0/2.25 cents over the print, with high sulphur 3.75 cents over the print.
